title: Pixel-art sky with puffy outlined clouds
purpose: Generate a pixel-art sky tile that repeats both ways at a chosen art resolution: a flat sky with faint dithered patches, cumulus clouds of round puffs on a flat base, lit from the top left with an optional outline, and stars at night, plus per-pixel normal, height, roughness and occlusion maps. For 2D backgrounds.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python pixel_cloud_sky.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: art_pixels
parameters.meaning: Art pixels along each side of the tile; the maps enlarge them with nearest-neighbour sampling.

parameters.name: clouds
parameters.meaning: Share of the evenly spread cloud positions that hold a cloud.

parameters.name: cloud_width
parameters.meaning: Typical cloud width in art pixels.

parameters.name: puffiness
parameters.meaning: Height of the puffs heaped above the cloud base.

parameters.name: outline
parameters.meaning: 1 rings each cloud with a one-pixel outline.

parameters.name: stars
parameters.meaning: Density of stars in the open sky.

parameters.name: relief
parameters.meaning: Strength of the per-pixel normal map.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Blue day sky with white outlined cumulus clouds.

presets.name: sunset
presets.description: Orange and pink evening sky with violet clouds lit gold from above.

presets.name: night
presets.description: Dark navy night sky with grey-blue clouds and stars.

presets.name: storm
presets.description: Heavy grey storm clouds filling a dark grey sky.

limits: A still frame of stylized pixel art, not a cloud simulation; for parallax motion, scroll the tile. The sky has no vertical gradient, because a gradient would not repeat vertically. Clouds are unions of circles with a flat base, painted from the top of the tile down, and the light from the top left is baked into their tones. Height and roughness only matter for lit 2D or 3D use. Output sizes that are not a whole multiple of art_pixels give art pixels of unequal widths. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate posterized to eighths.
technique_references: Poisson-disc sampling on a torus for cloud placement
Clouds as unions of circles cut by a base line
Tone selection from the offset along a light direction
Ordered dithering with a 4 x 4 Bayer matrix for sky patches
